intent: Placeholder when a list, page, or region has nothing to show. One piece.
useWhen: A list or table has no rows
A page section has no content yet
A panel needs a centered placeholder with optional actions
doNotUseWhen: Chart with no data — charts use their own emptyLabel
Loading with no content — use Spinner or LoadingAnimation

title.note: Primary heading for the empty state.

icon.note: Lucide export name. Shown in a circular media well. Not EmptyMedia.

media.note: Custom media slot. Compose kit Avatar or AvatarGroup. Not EmptyMedia.

actions.note: Action row. Compose kit Buttons only. Not EmptyContent.

outlined.note: Bordered empty state with surface-card background.

doNot: Do not invent EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription, or EmptyContent
Do not use glass, color-mix, or backdrop-blur
snippet: <Empty title="No projects yet" description="You haven't created any projects yet." icon="Folder" actions={<><Button>Create</Button><Button variant="secondary">Import</Button></>} />
